reason: 该插件的主要用途是为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供可安装的视觉主题增强效果：在界面中加入动态极光与粒子鲸鱼背景。分类为主题与布局方向是因为其功能聚焦于界面外观和可视化渲染，而非数据处理或外部服务集成。

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 插件，安装后可加载动态极光与粒子鲸鱼风格的界面背景效果。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness Web UI plugin that adds an animated aurora-and-particle whale style background to the interface after installation.

capabilities: Injects dynamic visual effects into DSH web interface
Applies multi-layer CSS-based animations and parallax transitions

reasons.code: README describes a multi-layer animated aurora background with parallax mouse movement, particle behavior, and glow effects for the DSH Web UI, indicating continuous client-side UI animation.
package.json defines a DSH web client plugin entrypoint (lib/index.js and lib/client.js) with a web platform bundle patch, showing it is a client-side UI plugin.
